newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks slip in moribund trade.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks slip in moribund trade.

text.p: Caracas stocks slipped in a moribund session that saw trade fall to nearly half of Monday's volume, brokers said.
"The bolsa was almost dead," said Banseco broker Simon Brad.

The market's 19-share index lost 0.6 percent to close at 4,587.97 points as six million shares traded to a total value of 797 million bolivars ($1.7 million), according to preliminary figures from the stock exchange.
Among traded issues, 23 fell, 10 rose and six closed flat.
